_comment: Every line the Booked card produces from plan-log-sent-plan.json against
plan-log-share-link.txt, in the order a coach reads them, as
CoachPlanLog.lines() flattens them. Written by hand from the spec, never
captured from the code that produces it: a fixture regenerated from the
code under test proves only that the code agrees with itself. Coach
iPhone and Coach Android check their own port against this same file.
The log in the link covers 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-16 and carries three
days: Mon 12 Oct (Lower A -- a warmup that must not be counted, a squat
session, four RDL sets asked and three logged, chin-ups with no weight,
and a leg press nobody asked for), Thu 15 Oct (Conditioning, booked by
nobody), and Fri 16 Oct (Lower B -- Bulgarian split squats short on the
right, with a left-side and a right-side warmup to exclude, and a row
done on a Smith machine where a barbell was asked for). The plan also
books Wed 14 Oct, which was not logged, and Sat 17 Oct, which is past
the end of the window the client sent.
today is 2026-10-18 and the window is eight weeks.
